[[File:Evian.png|thumb|250px|Evian]] '''Evian''' (Japanese: '''コロク''' ''Koroku'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG156|From Cradle to Save]]''. He is a student of [[Angela]]'s in a [[Pokémon Ninja School]] deep in the forest. After being assigned to keep an eye on {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, he later took them to the school, seeing they weren't the thieves that he was looking for. As part of the ninja training, Evian and Ash were assigned to find and capture Angela's {{p|Kecleon}}, which he almost did. He later helped defeat {{TRT}}, as they were the actual thieves who were stealing from them. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Evian's {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|RS}}. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Evian |pkmn=Ninjask |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Evian Ninjask.png |epnum=AG156 |epname=From Cradle To Save |desc={{p|Ninjask}} is Evian's only known Pokémon. It was used to search for Angela's {{p|Kecleon}} after she assigned the group to search for it. Later, it was captured by Team Rocket, but later freed by [[Ash's Grovyle]]. Ninjask's known moves are {{m|Sand Attack}} and {{m|Fury Swipes}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{bug color}}|bordercolor={{flying color}} |ja=高城元気 ''Motoki Takagi'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]] |fi=Petri Hanttu |fr_eu=David Macaluso |it=Massimo di Benedetto |es_la=Ricardo Bautista |es_eu=Jorge Saudinós |pt_br=Yuri Chesman}}
